metric_expectations.source_text: Out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs.
DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count.
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold.
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline.
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL.
metric_expectations.notes: Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because REC v1 realized_metrics copy OL metrics and OL-0029 does not include a 90-day contribution metric.
Preserved from D2-006 but not compared because REC v1 realized_metrics copy OL metrics and OL-0029 does not include free_parameter_count.

realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12dm / WP-S2c-76 uses the prior contiguous local data-year evaluation window, 2024-04-12 through 2025-04-11, as H-003 combined R1+R2 cycle 2 after WP-12dl cycle 1 used 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available 1d history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-003 REP-0004 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this report records explicit non-cloned bounded-window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0029 records sharpe above that threshold.
D2-006 uses strict gt semantics for DSR > 1.0; OL-0029 records dsr equal to 1.0, not greater than 1.0.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0029 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0029 records sensitivity_min_ratio above that threshold.
D2-006 requires cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL; OL-0029 records cost_drag_fraction below that threshold with positive gross PnL.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0029 records walk_forward_efficiency above that threshold.
